description.narrative: 1. SUBPROGRAMA A: TO STRENGTHEN PANAMA'S JUDICIAL SYSTEM TO REDUCE DELAYS IN THE LEGAL PROCESS, GUARANTEE DUE PROCESS OF LAW AND DIMINISH OBSTACLES FOR ACCESS. 2. SUBPROGRAMA B: TO IMPROVE THE QUALITY, EFICIENCY AND TRANSPAENCY OF THE ACTS AND PROCEDURES OF PUBLIC ADMINISTRATION. THE PROGRAMA HAS AS EXECUTING AGENCIES THE JUDICIAL BRANCH OF GOVERNMENT, THE PROSECUTOR'S OFFICE AND THE ATTORNEY GENERAL'S OFFICE.
